dedupe_keys.name: analysis code for a contactless waiting area observation layer delivered by minimally trained observers in a low acuity emergency department a prospective feasibility study

description: Istanbul Medeniyet University researchers publish Python analysis code for a 500-person feasibility study of observation in a low-acuity emergency waiting area. The August 2026 Zenodo package is free under MIT terms and documents Python 3.12.10 with pinned dependencies. It includes cohort construction, logistic models, a Firth estimator, sensitivity analyses and an exhaustive sign-vector bootstrap across ten observation sessions. These methods can help estimate service-process relationships or evaluate observation policies before parameterising a hospital simulation. Coverage is one prospective hospital study. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code. The required study workbook is deliberately absent because the stated ethics approval does not permit public sharing; obtaining it requires a separate author request. The published workflow therefore cannot be reproduced from the archive alone. Claims of exact numerical reproduction, uncertainty calibration and clinical effectiveness were not independently checked, and no access request was made.
